statements.__comment: Create HAS_IMAGE realtionship from lambda functions to the associated ECR image
statements.query:
MATCH (l:AWSLambda {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}) 
 WITH COLLECT(l) as lmbda_list 
 UNWIND lmbda_list as lmbda 
 MATCH (e:ECRImage {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}) 
 WHERE e.digest = 'sha256:' + lmbda.codesha256 
 MERGE (lmbda)-[r:HAS]->(e) 
 SET r.guard0_org_id = $GUARD0_ORG_ID, r.lastupdated = $UPDATE_TAG
MATCH (:AWSLambda {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID})-[r:HAS]->(:ECRImage {guard0_org_id: $GUARD0_ORG_ID}) WHERE r.guard0_org_id = $GUARD0_ORG_ID AND r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG DELETE (r)
